name: SC-Project
note: High-performance motorcycle exhaust manufacturer headquartered in Cassinetta di Lugagnano, metropolitan area of Milan (Wide Magazine/Piaggio Group, 2025-10-01). Present in the MotoGP paddock since the 2009 season; Aprilia Racing's exhaust supplier since 2022. Founders and owners Marco De Rossi and Stefano Lavazza. Not listed; deeper shareholding not documented in accessible sources.
